cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 57 since November 2022. A pastor (Mount Zion Missionary Baptist Church, Cathedral of Faith Baptist Church) and former orthopedic first assistant. Past chief of staff to the president of the Alabama State Missionary Baptist Convention and chairman of the Birmingham-Jefferson County Transit Authority.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Patrick Sellers was born or raised, or when he moved to Alabama. The pages did not list the specific bills he sponsored or their outcomes. His campaign site names legislative themes (teacher assault prevention, DHR oversight, workforce training, community safety) but gives no bill numbers or details we could verify. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion or school choice. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. We found no endorsements for him. We found no controversies. The Wikipedia entry is only a one-line stub.
